title: Sweetmilk
description: A mod that adds Honeymilk, a drink that clears negative effects and restores hunger.
body: # Sweetmilk Milk and honey, better together. Sweetmilk adds **Honeymilk**, a drink that combines a Milk Bucket and a Honey Bottle into one handy item, plus a golden upgrade for when you need something stronger. ## Honeymilk Honeymilk takes the best part of milk and the best part of honey: - **Clears only your negative effects.** Honeymilk removes just the harmful effects. - **Restores hunger and saturation**, so it feeds you as well as cures you. - **Always drinkable**, even on a full hunger bar. - **Gives back an empty glass bottle** when you finish it. **Recipe:** 1 Milk Bucket + 2 Honey Bottles. You keep the empty bucket. ![Crafting Recipe Honeymilk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e21f35401e407210151cfbb85018e8288b39d5d8.png) ## Golden Honeymilk A premium version for tougher moments. It does everything Honeymilk does, and adds the power of gold: - Restores more hunger and saturation. - Grants a burst of **Regeneration** and lasting **Absorption**, just like a Golden Apple. **Recipe:** 8 Gold Nuggets around a Honeymilk. ![Crafting Recipe Golden Honeymilk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4518d5bd3f82c5722ee774ac71b398b09306e3ee.png) ## Built to feel vanilla Sweetmilk is designed to fit right into the base game: - Both drinks sit in the **Food & Drinks** creative tab, next to the Honey Bottle. - A **Wandering Trader** sometimes offers Honeymilk for emeralds. - Two advancements, **Sweet Relief** and **Liquid Gold**, in the Husbandry tab. - Recipes unlock in the recipe book once you gather the ingredients. - Proper item tags, so other mods and data packs treat them as foods and drinks. - Available in 7 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. ## Requirements - Fabric Loader and Fabric API
